text_block_list.name: Troubled Woman
text_block_list.text: Huuuhm... What should I do?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Troubled Woman
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no... my shoelace suddenly broke on 
me, you see...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear... that does sound troublesome. In 
that case—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
It may only be a makeshift fix, but please 
use my shoelaces.

text_block_list.name: Troubled Woman
text_block_list.text:
Wait, really?! For you to go that far for 
me...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it's quite alright. I'm already on 
my way back, and I can easily get new 
shoelaces once I return to the Academy.

text_block_list.name: Student
text_block_list.text:
*pant* *pant*... Pisa-chan, thanks for 
running alongside me!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you are most welcome. Please feel 
free to call on me anytime.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Victoire Pisa, whom I occasionally see on 
the course, is gentle as always and kind 
to everyone.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed. As if she weren't even aware of 
the representative selection at all—"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
However, as for this path leading to the 
world— I am sorry, but I cannot yield it 
to anyone.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Let us both give it our all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her feelings regarding the Prix de l'Arc 
de Triomphe are far from ordinary. There's 
no doubt about that.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Trainer-san. Is something the 
matter?
choice_data_list: I want you to keep <chrname> company.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course I don't mind. However—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...Side-by-side training? Or as a mock 
race?
choice_data_list:
...I'd like us to give it everything we've 
got.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
“...... Understood. I will give it 
everything I have right now.”

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaahh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And the running Victoire Pisa displayed 
did not disappoint— no, it was far more 
terrifying than anyone could have 
predicted.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...Phew. I already knew it, but... they're 
truly strong.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Even so, I cannot yield the way.
choice_data_list:
What's your reason for wanting to run in 
the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe?

Why do you want to run in the Prix de 
l'Arc de Triomphe?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...It is to connect our 'bonds' across the 
world.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so—Victoire Pisa began to speak of an 
event from her Junior year.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ...Now then. What should I do?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: —Are you troubled? About that matter?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
What, did you hear it from Yayoi? Or was 
it from Tazuna-san?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...Challenging the 'Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe' during the Classic Year. So that 
is what you are considering.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ――... Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Challenging the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe 
in the Classic Year carries many 
advantages. If that path is forged, the 
chances of conquering the race will 
increase.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"Still... the adjustments required are on 
a completely different scale compared to 
domestic races. You'd be spending 
irreplaceable time spanning from the 
Junior to Classic Class."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
In other words... it is practically asking 
me to stake my entire racing career on the 
Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: It's not a leap to be taken lightly.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...... Even so.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"I am—prepared to wager everything on the 
Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
No matter what the outcome may be, I will 
have no regrets.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ...Why do you have such resolve?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
—A long time ago, I saw something truly 
wonderful. A single, shining "ring."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
It is the sight of everyone in the stands 
enveloped in frenzy and excitement, 
receiving hope and courage before the 
race.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
The reason I run is that I want to connect 
as many people as possible through such a 
"circle."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"If I can deliver an amazing performance 
in the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe—I'm sure 
I can expand that circle across the entire 
world."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"...I want to see that. It is well worth 
staking everything on."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
So... please, I beg of you. Give me—the 
chance to run.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...A 'bond' that spans the world. A cause 
worthy of betting everything on, is it?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
(............ If there's a girl who feels 
that way about me...)

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: —Shall we open it? The gate.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...I know you all have your own reasons 
not to lose. You have dreams. You carry 
all your fans' hopes on your shoulders... 
I understand that.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Even so—I want to win. I don't want to 
waste the opportunity I was given.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: To spread the "circle" to the world.
